title: How to use this template
use_cases: Use when building a foundational character profile for creative writing
Implement when mapping out physical and demographic details for story consistency
Use when developing internal motivations and behavioral contradictions for realistic personas
Configure when establishing a character's socioeconomic and political standing
Use when drafting first impressions and sensory details for a protagonist or antagonist
content:
- ✦ Pay close attention to the Goals & Motivation section — it's the engine of your story
- ✦ Contradict yourself intentionally — real people are inconsistent
- ✦ Keep answers in a document and reference them while drafting
- ✦ Some answers will surprise you and change your story in good ways
- ✦ You don't need to answer every question — answer what serves your story
